normalized.title: Lot 2 - Jacket and topsides design
normalized.description: This lot consists of the conceptual design of jacket and topside as part of energy hub concepts (i.e. in a total offshore energy system context). The deliverables foreseen are building blocks of the feasibility study of various offshore structure concepts and their implication for the system design. Examples include feasibility studies into compressor and electrolysis platforms. For compressor platforms this, as an example regards the identification of size/capacity per compressor platform, development and mechanical design, vibration and pulsation studies of centralized compressor platforms, structural analysis and further refinement of the implications of design choices on system cost, scope and the supply chain. For electrolysis platforms this entails the assessment on how different types of electrolysis technologies (e.g. PEM or alkaline) can be realized mechanically/structurally and how they can be integrated in the system (i.e. in relation to the offshore electricity network and the offshore hydrogen network). Furthermore the studies shall aim to assess the spatial impact of such platforms and analyze the implication of various concepts for operating and maintaining such infrastructure as well as technical levers to influence CAPEX and OPEX. Gasunie regards project engineering services as the services needed to execute and partner with Gasunie; to this end regular project status reports, concluding reports and report-outs and support in drafting internal decision-notes (for instance on explored alternatives and the associated evaluation those) are part of the scope of work.

normalized.description: To develop a Power Management IC with low voltage dynamic point of load regulation able to supply independently multiplesupply rails.Description: Exploration in harsh environments with long lunar nights and limited amount of energy poses difficult challenges for the success of these missions. Traditional standby modes, which consume a substantial amount of power when inactive, have proven detrimental for applications of this nature. By utilizing advanced power management techniques such as dynamic voltage scaling, selective rail supply, and sequenced control of FPGAs and microcontrollers, significant energy savings can be achieved. This Power Management ICs could be utilized in all the processing boards reducing not only the consumption during the long eclipses by entering into deep hibernation modes but also during the sun phase by adapting the consumption of the processors to their workload. Under this activity an Power Management Integrated Circuit (PMIC) is developed that is able to supply multiple rail voltages required by FPGAs andmicrocontrollers. The supply voltages are able to adapt dynamically to the workload of the FPGA or microcontroller, even switching-off non used logic, improving significantly their energy efficiency. The activity encompasses the following tasks: - Requirement consolidation - Analysis of suitable Architectures for Power Management ICs - Design and development of a Power- Test and test results assessmen

Title: Germany – Electrical wiring and fitting work – Erweiterung Grundschulcampus Wildau - Los 14 - Elektroinstallation
Procedure title: Erweiterung Grundschulcampus Wildau - Los 14 - Elektroinstallation
Description: Die Stadt Wildau beabsichtigt an dem Standort der Grundschule Wildau und der KiTa Wirbelwind in der Fichtestr. 90, 15745 Wildau, einen neuen Grundschulcampus zu errichten. Dazu werden die Höfe zu einem Schulgelände zusammengefasst und Gebäude teilweise abgerissen. Das bestehende Schulgebäude wird mit einem neuen Anbau und angeschlossener Sporthalle erweitert, der zu erhaltene Bestand im Nordwesten wird teilweise saniert. Der Schulhof wird nach Abriss der alten Gebäude und dem Neubau großräumig neugestaltet. Der Neubau der Grundschule stellt den Hauptbaukörper dar, der sich entlang der Käthe-Kollwitz-Straße im Süden erstreckt. Gleich im Anschluss folgt auf gleicher Front (Ostseite) der Giebel der Sporthalle mit unterlagerter Mensa und Austeilküche. An der westlichen Seite schließt der Neubau an das Bestandsgebäude an. Die Sporthalle befindet sich im 1. Obergeschoss oberhalb von Mensa und Küche; sie besteht aus einer Drei-Feld-Sporthalle, Nebenfunktionsflächen und einer Galerie im 2. Obergeschoss. Grundschule und Sporthalle sind nicht unterkellert. Die tragenden Bauteile bestehen aus Stahlbeton und aus KS-Mauerwerk. Die Gründung ist eine Stahlbetonfundamentplatte mit Frostschürzen aus Betonstreifenfundamenten.
